_about: How the lenses walk an organization's controlled assets. A lens reads its whole footprint, a round at a time, bounded only by its time or an optional limit. focus names, for a lens, the OAM asset types it reads from the footprint; that lens's walk then admits and follows only those types and the types the semantics table says can lead to them, so it spends its reads and time on what it reports. A lens without an entry walks every type. skip_hosted_urls are lenses that never read URL assets: their footprint walk leaves out a URL reached from a host name (a page under the host, which leads only back to that host) and counts it, so pages stored by crawls and web archives are not read. A URL reached from an organization (its website) is still admitted, since it can be the only path to a name. Add values here, not in Go code.
